name: Edit Image - Qwen 2.1
summary: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo Q4_K_M GGUF: faster 8-step image editing on Cloud9. Original INT8 checkpoint retained for rollback; same VAE and Qwen3-VL encoder.

source.notes: Only the Qwen2.1 Turbo DiT loader changed from original native INT8 to validated Unsloth Q4_K_M GGUF. Full real Freefield 768px A/B and native Comfy production-profile run PASS on Cloud9 2026-11-23; original INT8 is retained as physical backup and previous immutable Docker image for rollback. No Qwen2511/2509 change. Benchmark receipt Freefield/ComfyUI/benchmarks/00f-qwen21-turbo-q4-default-runtime-20261123-retry1.json, 571.20 s. Native GGUF uses up to 10.558 GiB shared GTT vs INT8 7.734 GiB, so retain existing host memory admission and protection; no global profile change.

inputs.label: Editing instruction
inputs.default: Change only the background to a pastel lavender wall, preserving the person, face and original camera angle.
inputs.help: Indiquer exactement la modification, puis ce qui doit rester identique (identité, pose, cadrage, arrière-plan). Utiliser une référence nette.

inputs.label: Avoid
inputs.default: distorted face, extra limbs, artifacts, blurry details, warped background
inputs.help: Le profil de référence validé utilise CFG 8 : le négatif participe à la guidance. Décrire aussi dans le prompt principal ce qui doit rester identique.

credits: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo original multimodal image editing model
Comfy-Org Qwen3-VL 8B INT8 ConvRot text encoder and Qwen-Image-2.1 bf16 VAE unchanged
Original INT8 ConvRot diffusion weight retained locally as rollback, with no duplicate GGUF download

test.prompt: Change only the background behind the person to a soft lavender pastel wall, keeping face and hair intact.
